id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e54: "We hid the women and children deep in the bastion, but if monsters attack, we can do nothing...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f38: "{var:1}, I know your feelings are complicated, but please fight beside the hero and help us.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|305c: "The bastion has escaped danger for now... If not for Hendrik and you, who knows what would have happened. Thank you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3108: "By the way, {var:1}, the King of Heliodor is calling you. He's waiting in the king's tent.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31b4: "The messenger soldier looked serious, so it must be important. You'd better hear him out soon.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3394: "The messenger soldier looked serious, so it must be important. You'd better hear him out soon.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3304: "The King of Heliodor is calling you. He's waiting in the king's tent.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3580: "If something happened to you fighting the monster of the everlasting dark, Gemma would be so sad.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3640: "I don't want to see that girl's sad face. Make sure you come back safe.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3740: "The King of Heliodor is calling for you. Hurry and go see him.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|37e0: "Since this is the village that raised the Luminary, this time we'll surely get a reward from the king.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3890: "...Just kidding. Don't take it seriously. Hahaha.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3980: "You saved us without giving up in any hardship. You are truly the chosen Luminary.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a2c: "As long as you have that unyielding heart, you can keep moving forward on the harsh adventure ahead.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3af8: "{var:1}, defeat this so-called Dark One and come back to this village.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3bd0: "Just between us, without you Gemma doesn't smile at all. As her grandfather, I'm terribly worried.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3c88: "This trip shouldn't be long, so bring her a souvenir when you return and make her smile.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3e78: "This trip shouldn't be long, so bring her a souvenir when you return and make her smile.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3fcc: "Honestly, that King of Heliodor... After throwing us in a cell so long, thinking he can make up over a meal. How shameless!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|41b4: "Honestly, that King of Heliodor... After throwing us in a cell so long, thinking he can make up over a meal. How shameless!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40a8: "Even if he tries to fool me with this lavish meal, I... I...

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4380: "{var:1}... It's been a long road, but it all began here.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4414: "Go now. This time the king will meet you, and it's time he acknowledges you as the Luminary...!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4528: "{var:1}... I thought your long journey was finally over, but it seems the time hasn't come yet.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46e8: "{var:1}... I thought your long journey was finally over, but it seems the time hasn't come yet.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|45d4: "First go check the sky. Judging by how flustered the king and soldiers are, something's very wrong.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4794: "Now you're Cobblestone's representative. See it through to the end. Quitting halfway won't feel right.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|48a8: "To think this would happen. When I sent you off from the village, I never dreamed of it.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4958: "...Don't make that face. It's all right, everyone in the village understands. It's not your fault.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4a78: "Thanks to the people you found, the village is finally back to its old self. Thank you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4fb8: "Thanks to the people you found, the village is finally back to its old self. Thank you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4b54: "But we can't be the only ones calling for help. The whole world needs your strength.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5094: "But we can't be the only ones calling for help. The whole world needs your strength.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4c08: "Answering the world's expectations is the Luminary's mission. It's hard, but do your best.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5148: "Answering the world's expectations is the Luminary's mission. It's hard, but do your best.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4d20: "When Gemma first told me she wanted to marry you, I was quite surprised.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5260: "When Gemma first told me she wanted to marry you, I was quite surprised.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4dc0: "But as you traveled on as the Luminary, you grew into a fine adult. I saw that through the rebuilding.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5300: "But as you traveled on as the Luminary, you grew into a fine adult. I saw that through the rebuilding.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e94: "...She's a tomboy of a granddaughter, but please take care of her for years to come, my boy.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|53d4: "...She's a tomboy of a granddaughter, but please take care of her for years to come, my boy.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|54dc: "{var:1}, you did truly well. True peace has come to Erdrea thanks to you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|56e4: "{var:1}, you did truly well. True peace has come to Erdrea thanks to you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5588: "It must have been hard and painful, but you fulfilled the Luminary's mission. I'm truly proud of you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5790: "It must have been hard and painful, but you fulfilled the Luminary's mission. I'm truly proud of you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5864: "And that hero is now my dear granddaughter's husband. I couldn't be happier. Hahaha.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6624: "I don't know what happened with the king, but resenting people gets you nowhere. First, talk with him properly.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6700: "The King of Heliodor's tent is north of the village. Go on. ...But don't you start a fight, hear?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|67f4: "I heard he's coming back to the bastion, and everyone around here went to welcome him.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|68a0: "Though he's a Heliodor general, he's always kind to us. A truly big-hearted hero.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|69f8: "The King of Heliodor ordered that non-fighters hide deep in the bastion since danger is closing in.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6af0: "...Oh, don't worry about us! If monsters come, Mum's special fist will give them a good bonk!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6c6c: "{var:1}! Mum knew from the start you'd never lose to a few monsters like that.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6d10: "Have you reported this victory? The king will be delighted, so go to his tent first.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6e44: "Work together with Hendrik and fulfill your duty. Everyone's waiting, believing in you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6f00: "It's so dark I can't even see your face. So next time, show me your face properly under the sun.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7030: "{var:1}, remember this. Luminary who saves the world or not, you're my son.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|70ec: "Save the world quickly and come back to Cobblestone.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7168: "I'll make a big pot of your favorite stew and wait for you forever.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|729c: "{var:1}, going on another journey? You just beat the Dark One, and Luminaries are so busy.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|735c: "Honestly! You can't sit still when something bothers you, just like Grandpa Chalky.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|73e8: "Well, no use saying anything now. ...You've decided, haven't you? Then go adventure until you're satisfied.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|74bc: "Gemma, me, and the whole village look forward to your return. Now, off you go.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75d0: "{var:1}... General Hendrik told me you went through terrible hardship where we couldn't see.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|78b0: "{var:1}... General Hendrik told me you went through terrible hardship where we couldn't see.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|769c: "Because you kept going without giving up, the king's misunderstanding cleared and we can go outside again...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|797c: "Because you kept going without giving up, the king's misunderstanding cleared and we can go outside again...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7770: "You really are my pride and joy. Mum couldn't be happier that you've grown into a fine man.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a50: "You really are my pride and joy. Mum couldn't be happier that you've grown into a fine man.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7b74: "{var:1}... You really did your best. There's no happier day for Mum.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7c1c: "Now go meet the king. Grandpa in heaven will watch over your fine appearance too.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7d18: "Sandy, what's wrong, Sandy...? You don't need to be so scared, I'm here, it's all right.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7df0: "{var:1}... You finally met the real King of Heliodor, and now you must travel again?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7e98: "As Grandpa said, you must carry a great mission. Be careful out there, {var:1}.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7fd4: "Welcome back, {var:1}. You came back safe. That alone makes Mum happy.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|805c: "It's a mess as you see, but the bed at least is fine. You must be tired. Rest.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|811c: "Good morning! It's morning, {var:1}. Now go on. Don't worry about us here.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|81dc: "Your journey will have many hardships, but never give up. Grandpa in heaven would laugh at you!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8324: "Goodness, you're all battered. Are you all right? Now you're back, so rest well tonight.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|84d4: "The village is back to normal, so there's nothing to worry about now, right? Go fulfill your mission.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|85ac: "The world awaits you. Now go! My pride and joy, {var:1}!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|86a8: "Tonight I'll stay at the village chief's house. You two newlyweds, relax together.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8770: "Everyone gave you such a grand wedding and blessings. Make sure you make Gemma happy.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8964: "Another fine day. Thanks to you saving the world, everyone in the village lives in peace.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8a2c: "Come on, don't be groggy. Go greet everyone.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8ad0: "{var:1}, how are things lately with Gemma?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8bb8: "You seem surprisingly lovey-dovey. But don't get carried away and cause Gemma trouble with your demands.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8c68: "A beautiful, good-natured girl like her becoming your wife is nearly a miracle.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8d18: "Be sure to make her happy. That's a promise to your mother.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8e20: "Hey, {var:1}! I bet you're making demands and troubling Gemma.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8e98: "A beautiful, good-natured girl like her becoming your wife is nearly a miracle!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|8f48: "If you don't make her happy, I won't forgive you!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9028: "Going on another journey? I was relieved you returned safe, but you really are a handful.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|90f8: "The monsters are gone, so it shouldn't be too dangerous, but be careful on your way.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9c3c: "Oh, {var:1}. Gemma should be somewhere in the castle. If you're curious, why not look for her?

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9cc4: "You and Gemma are of age. If you want to be together someday, say something thoughtful at times like this.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9f84: "{var:1}... How long has it been since I saw you off from Cobblestone?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a01c: "I never imagined I'd see you blessed by so many people like this...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a11c: "Ugh... what is this evil presence... It's hard even to breathe.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a200: "The King of Heliodor said we may stay here, but...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a260: "Once things settle in the castle, we plan to return to Cobblestone. That is our home.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a368: "My, we got hit hard. It'll take time to restore the village to normal.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a45c: "Your journey is for an important mission. Don't worry about this village, do as you think best.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a524: "Don't worry, the people here are far tougher than you think. They'll stand up again and again.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a614: "...I always hoped so since you were little, but to think you'd become Gemma's husband.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a6a4: "Cherish your life. If you make that girl sad, I won't forgive you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a838: "A baby was born to my relatives recently. A dear, jewel-like baby.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a8ec: "While Yggdrasil, the source of life, exists, new lives are born as old ones are lost. This cycle continues forever.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aa24: "Someday we too will be called to heaven and return to Yggdrasil, but until then we must live earnestly.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bc9c: "There are people waiting for you to come back! Come on, {var:1}! Follow me!

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bdf4: "We use that tent too, so it's not clean and a bit small, but a good sleep will cure your fatigue.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c04c: "Yawn... I'm getting sleepy. Maybe I'll sleep with {var:1}. ...Just kidding. Hehe.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c1e4: "We're safe thanks to him. I want to thank him properly someday.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c454: "{var:1}, please. Don't push yourself or get hurt... Come back to me.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c544: "{var:1}! You're safe! Are you hurt? Does anything hurt?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c684: "...Just kidding! I'll treat you properly later!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c794: "...Oops! As expected of my childhood friend {var:1}. I believed you'd be fine!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c8d8: Gemma seemed to smile a little.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c9a0: "The king told me. You're taking on the mission to dispel the everlasting dark.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ca30: "You finally came back, so why must it always be {var:1} going on dangerous fights...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cb40: "It's something only {var:1} can do. I believe in you. Dispel the darkness and come back to the bastion.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc68: "A message from the King of Heliodor: he has an important matter for you and wants you to come to his tent.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cd94: "...Hehe. Just kidding. The King of Heliodor would never do that again.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ce8c: "...{var:1}, you're going on another journey. And to save the world. It must be a far harsher road than before.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cf6c: "...But I believe in you. You'll surely defeat the Dark One. I believe we can live together in a peaceful world.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d068: "I'll wait and wait for {var:1} to come back.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d160: "{var:1}, you're going on another journey. I don't think it will be long this time, but... I'll miss you a little.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d34c: "But don't keep me waiting too long. Come back to our village soon. Now, off you go, {var:1}.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d52c: "Listen, {var:1}... After we all go home and finish rebuilding the village, I want to be with you again...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d5ec: "...No, never mind. {var:1} has a mission as the Luminary.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d9a8: "It must be good news. {var:1}, hold your head high and go meet the king.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dc6c: "I planned to go home to Cobblestone after talking to the king, but that looks impossible.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dd34: "It must be hard with the Luminary's mission, but stop by Cobblestone on your journey. It's your home after all.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|efcc: "Another fine day. Thanks to you saving the world, everyone in the village lives in peace.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f094: "Come on, don't be groggy. Go greet everyone.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f188: "What, you're going on another journey? You haven't been back long. You really love adventure...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f25c: "I don't mind if it's not dangerous. Knowing you, you'd go even if I stopped you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f2fc: "But you're the head of the family, so come back as soon as you can. We'll have a new family member soon... hehe.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fa10: "I grumble a lot, but {var:1} is my pride, a husband who saved the world.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|facc: "I've never once regretted marrying you. I'll keep following you as ever.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fb80: "{var:1}, I love you. Let's live together forever.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fca0: "You're the head of the family, so come back as soon as you can. We'll have a new family member soon...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fd74: "...What's with that face? Did you forget? I told you the other day Sandy's puppies are due soon.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fe28: "They'll surely be the cutest babies. I can't wait. Hehe.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ff84: "Oh! You're the Luminary?! Quite a skinny lad, but are you eating enough meat?!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1016: "Oh! You're the Luminary?! Quite a skinny lad, but are you eating enough meat?!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1003: "If you're going to save the world, eat plenty of my cooking! Full of love and nutrition! Hahaha!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1021: "If you're going to save the world, eat plenty of my cooking! Full of love and nutrition! Hahaha!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1034: "Oh! Luminary!! Such a skinny body, but are you eating enough meat?!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|103d: "Judging by that silky hair, you eat only fruit and vegetables, don't you? To get strong, eat meat!!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1057: "Oh... Luminary?! Coming to such a sweltering place, you're quite eccentric.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1073: "Oh... Luminary?! Coming to such a sweltering place, you're quite eccentric.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1062: "The cook is fired up for the first feast in ages. I hope you enjoy it a little.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|107e: "The cook is fired up for the first feast in ages. I hope you enjoy it a little.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|108d: "The Cobblestone folk went to the entrance to see the Luminary off. Please go see them.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|109d: "The Luminary's hometown Cobblestone folk have returned to their quarters. Please go see them if you like.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10ae: "The Luminary's hometown Cobblestone folk have returned to their quarters. Please go see them if you like.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10c3: "The king says a dead man's room is a waste, so I'm clearing out Jasper's room. But my hands won't move.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10e3: "The king says a dead man's room is a waste, so I'm clearing out Jasper's room. But my hands won't move.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10d2: "Jasper served the king for years alongside Hendrik. To treat him like this is too cruel...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10f1: "Jasper served the king for years alongside Hendrik. To treat him like this is too cruel...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1103: "While Hendrik travels with the Luminary, I'll keep the room neat and tidy on my own responsibility.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|110f: "For Hendrik, who's been in the castle since childhood, this room is like home...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1122: "So many people have passed out drunk. It's been so long since a castle banquet that everyone's unused to drinking.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1133: "It's noisy... Did some drunk start a fight? Everyone's too rowdy just because it's a banquet.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1142: "That grand banquet was ordered by the monster possessing the king. It makes me feel complicated.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1150: "Luckily nothing odd seemed to be in the food, but I worry about upset stomachs later.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|116d: "Yawn... This floor is so comfy I fell fast asleep.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1174: "But the soldiers by the throne room are noisy. Did something happen...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1182: "Before I knew it, some maid kept a cat without asking. It won't leave and I'm troubled.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11a2: "These cells hold petty criminals and suspects under investigation. We hid the Cobblestone folk here too.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11dc: "I heard rumors... You've traveled the world, Gallopolis, Sniflheim...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11e9: "You look much sturdier than when I first saw you here. You must have gone through much hardship.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11f8: "Ugh... I drank too much. Such a fun night hasn't happened since the day Jade was born...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|120f: "After monsters attacked his homeland Bandelphon, Hendrik was taken in by the king and served him in gratitude.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1221: "But that king was a monster... How must General Hendrik feel after serving a monster all this time...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1231: "I thought it was time for the real king to bless the Luminary, but what's wrong in this joyous setting...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1242: "We are proud Heliodor soldiers. While General Hendrik is away, we'll guard Heliodor Castle.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1281: "Morning has come, morning has come. A light for tomorrow shines on us...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|128a: "It's a famous Heliodor song, but this Last Bastion, where morning never comes, had no use for it...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|129f: "As a bard, I decided to leave my last words as a song. If you like it, pass it on.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ad: "Now let's sing goodbye. Everything is over, over at last. The terrible night is over.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12b5: "The corpse army extends the road to the underworld toward the Last Bastion. Everything is over, over at last.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12c4: "Sun people of strong heart, sing, sing a song of joy...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12cd: "This victory brought smiles back to the bastion. The time for victory that suits this song will come. ...I feel that now.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12e6: "A song of joy now echoes. Morning has come, morning has come. A light for tomorrow shines on us~
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|131f: "A song of joy now echoes. Morning has come, morning has come. A light for tomorrow shines on us~
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12f1: "The great eagle soars the sky and praises us. The mountain and river waters, clear, will heal us.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|132a: "The great eagle soars the sky and praises us. The mountain and river waters, clear, will heal us.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12fd: "Sing, people of Heliodor! Sun people of strong heart! Sing, sing a song of joy~
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1336: "Sing, people of Heliodor! Sun people of strong heart! Sing, sing a song of joy~
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1309: "It's a famous Heliodor song. It suits the Last Bastion, where the sun has returned!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1342: "It's a famous Heliodor song. It suits the Last Bastion, where the sun has returned!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1356: "The red star shining in the sky is called the Luminary's star.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|136e: "But am I imagining it? It looks larger than before...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|137e: "What waist and footwork... He improvises along with my song. This entertainer is no ordinary man...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|138c: "With him, I could aim for the top of the world. Ah, I wish he'd travel with me as my partner...!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|139e: "...Shudder. A terrible story. I heard a commotion in the guest room and then my fingers stopped moving.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13ab: "I don't know what happened, but fear has surely seized my body. I can't perform at a time like this...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13bf: "Oh, Luminary, legendary Luminary. His name is {var:1}, setting out on a new journey~
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13c9: "Inheriting Erdwin's name, heeding the king's wish, he weaves a myth yet unseen. His name is {var:1}, la la la~
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13ec: "...Luminary, please forgive us. It was all a tragedy born of the misunderstanding that the Luminary is a child of the devil.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13f9: "The Luminary will never be seized again.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1404: "It's a joyous occasion so it can't be helped, but some soldiers are overdoing it, and it makes me nervous.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|140f: "The king seems to be resting in his room, but if he wakes at the noise... Oh, how terrifying!!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|141f: "Oh, how terrifying. What lies ahead...? I'm too scared to move.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|142d: "Oh, Luminary. I'm honored you speak even to a mere maid like me.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1437: "The king has waited in the throne room since morning. Please go ahead.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1446: "What an eerie sky. I have a bad feeling.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|144e: "A soldier who went to the throne room muttered about the Luminary's star. What happened to that symbol?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|145f: "Luminary, you're setting out again. I know nothing of the circumstances, but I pray for a safe journey.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1484: "Jasper's whereabouts are unknown. The king doesn't seem concerned. What on earth happened?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1495: "That man... what stamina. Since the banquet began, he's danced for hours without rest.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14a2: "And his moves grow sharper, nearly stealing my heart. I've never seen this entertainer. Who is he?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14b4: "A noise came from the guest room and then a dog began barking. Probably sensing evil.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14c1: "I'm a swordsman myself. I feel the evil drifting through the castle, but see no monster. Odd.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14d6: "While on outer patrol, I happened to look up at the sky and noticed the Luminary's star was odd.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14e3: "That's probably related to the Luminary. For some reason I can't help thinking so.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14f2: "General Hendrik goes with the Luminary. The general is like a shield protecting all of Heliodor.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1501: "While General Hendrik is away, we'll protect the king. Please take care...!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1511: "Welcome back, Luminary. The king has been waiting. Please report to him.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1520: "The king never said anything before, but he truly agonized over Jade...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|152c: "Hearing his words nearby, I nearly cried, but I mustn't show weakness before the king...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|153f: "Why, Jasper... Why did you do such a thing...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1548: "My lord, the King of Heliodor, was not a king nor a human...? Then what did I believe in all this time...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1563: "The Luminary's star fell... What is going to happen...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|156e: "{var:1}, I have a bad feeling. Go see how the Luminary's star looks.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|157a: "The star fell toward the Celestial Sands. Go to the Emerald Coast and you may see something. I'm counting on you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1594: "Oh, you're back, {var:1}! So? Did you learn anything about the Luminary's star?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|159e:
{var:1} told him what he saw
on the Emerald Coast.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15a6: "What, an ominous black sun floating over Gallopolis!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15b2: "Hmm... The Luminary's star became a black sun... What does this mean...?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15be: "{var:1}, the Luminary, keep investigating the black sun's true nature. Come to me if you learn anything.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15dc: "Oh, {var:1}! You who bear Erdwin's name! I've been waiting for your return.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15e7: "So, what did you learn about the sky's anomaly?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15ee:
{var:1} told him what he learned
in the Havens Above.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15f7: "The ancient evil god Calasmos... Such a mighty being has revived on the surface...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1605: "{var:1}, the Luminary. The world's people still don't even know the name Calasmos.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1611: "But at this rate, the world will soon be destroyed by the evil god.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|161a: "Please defeat Calasmos with your own hands and restore peace to this land! I'm counting on you, Luminary {var:1}!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1630: "The Jade I knew was a frail young girl... She has grown up in these sixteen years.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|163e: "I regret not seeing my daughter grow, but if meeting you helped her grow, nothing makes me happier.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|164e: "{var:1}, the Luminary. Keep looking after Jade... and Heliodor, I ask.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16b8: "I see. The escaped criminal on the wanted poster had the same hairstyle, I thought.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16c4: "I've been on high alert lately, so I've grown suspicious. I apologize.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16d5: "I see, of course. Come to think of it, the escaped criminal on the wanted poster had the same hairstyle...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16e2: "...Well, no criminal would escape and come back. I'm sorry I doubted you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16f5: "Oh, Luminary {var:1}. I was terribly rude back then. Please forgive me...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1700: "I heard from the King of Heliodor. Please come to the castle. He is waiting eagerly.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1710: "Luminary, please come to the castle. The king is waiting eagerly.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1725: "The banquet is still going at the castle. The guest of honor mustn't leave. Please return to the castle.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1736: "The banquet is still going at the castle. The guest of honor mustn't leave. Please return to the castle.

tm.「{var:1}……よく帰ってきてくれた。\n 何も知らずに おぬしを送りだして: "{var:1}... Thank you for coming back. Forgive a foolish old man who sent you off knowing nothing...
tm.「デルカダールの お城では\n 英雄殿が わしらを気にかけてくれた おかげで\n: "At Heliodor Castle, the hero looked after us, so we weren't treated roughly, but...
tm.「大樹が落ちた あの日の混乱で\n 皆 バラバラに なってしもうて。\n 気がつ: "In the chaos the day the great tree fell, we were all scattered. Before I knew it, these were all the Cobblestone folk left...
tm.「なぜ こんなことに なったのかのう。\n 大地の精霊さまは どこにおられるのじ: "Why did this happen? Where is the Earth Spirit? Has she abandoned us...
tm.「女子供は 砦の奥に隠したが\n もしも 魔物たちが 砦に攻め入れば\n わしら: "We hid the women and children deep in the bastion, but if monsters attack, we can do nothing...
tm.「{var:1}よ。\n おぬしの複雑な気持ちも わかるが\n 英雄殿と共に戦い: "{var:1}, I know your feelings are complicated, but please fight beside the hero and help us.
tm.「ひとまず 砦は危機を脱した……。\n グレイグさまと おぬしが おらなかったら: "The bastion has escaped danger for now... If not for Hendrik and you, who knows what would have happened. Thank you.
tm.「それは そうと {var:1}。\n デルカダールの王さまが おぬしを呼んでお: "By the way, {var:1}, the King of Heliodor is calling you. He's waiting in the king's tent.
tm.「伝言の兵士は 真剣なカオをしておったから\n 何か 大切な用に違いない……。\: "The messenger soldier looked serious, so it must be important. You'd better hear him out soon.
tm.「デルカダールの王さまが おぬしを呼んでおる。\n 王のテントで 待っておられる: "The King of Heliodor is calling you. He's waiting in the king's tent.
tm.「常闇を生む魔物を 倒しにいって\n おぬしに もしものことがあったら\n 孫の: "If something happened to you fighting the monster of the everlasting dark, Gemma would be so sad.
tm.「わしは あの子の悲しむカオを見とうはない。\n かならず 無事に帰ってくるのじ: "I don't want to see that girl's sad face. Make sure you come back safe.
tm.「デルカダールの王さまが\n おぬしのことを 呼んでいるそうじゃよ。\n 早く: "The King of Heliodor is calling for you. Hurry and go see him.
tm.「勇者さまを 育てた村ということで\n 今度こそ 王さまから\n ほうびを もら: "Since this is the village that raised the Luminary, this time we'll surely get a reward from the king.
tm.「……な～んての。冗談じゃよ 冗談。\n 本気にするでない。わっはっは。: "...Just kidding. Don't take it seriously. Hahaha.
tm.「どんな困難にも へこたれず\n わしらを救ってくれた おぬしは\n まごうこと: "You saved us without giving up in any hardship. You are truly the chosen Luminary.
tm.「おぬしを待つ つらく険しい冒険の道も\n その あきらめぬ心さえあれば\n き: "As long as you have that unyielding heart, you can keep moving forward on the harsh adventure ahead.
tm.「{var:1}。\n かならずや 魔王とやらを倒し\n この村へ 帰ってくるの: "{var:1}, defeat this so-called Dark One and come back to this village.
tm.「ここだけの話 お前がおらぬと\n エマは ちっとも 笑わないんじゃ。\n 祖父: "Just between us, without you Gemma doesn't smile at all. As her grandfather, I'm terribly worried.
tm.「今度の旅は そんなに長くならんじゃろうし\n 帰ってくる時に 土産のひとつでも: "This trip shouldn't be long, so bring her a souvenir when you return and make her smile.
tm.「まったく デルカダール王め……。\n こんなに長い間 牢に放りこんでおきながら: "Honestly, that King of Heliodor... After throwing us in a cell so long, thinking he can make up over a meal. How shameless!
tm.「こんな 豪勢なメシで ごまかそうとしても\n わしは……わしは……。: "Even if he tries to fool me with this lavish meal, I... I...
tm.「{var:1}よ……。\n 今まで ずいぶん長い道のりだったが\n すべては: "{var:1}... It's been a long road, but it all began here.
tm.「さあ 行くがよい。\n 今度こそ 王に会い 勇者として\n 認めてもらう時が来: "Go now. This time the king will meet you, and it's time he acknowledges you as the Luminary...!
tm.「{var:1}よ……。\n そなたの長い旅も ようやく終わると思ったが\n ま: "{var:1}... I thought your long journey was finally over, but it seems the time hasn't come yet.
tm.「まずは 空の様子を見てくるがよい。\n 王や兵士の あわてぶりを見る限り\n: "First go check the sky. Judging by how flustered the king and soldiers are, something's very wrong.
tm.「まあ こうなったら イシの村の代表として\n 最後まで やりきってくるんじゃ。: "Now you're Cobblestone's representative. See it through to the end. Quitting halfway won't feel right.
tm.「まさか こんなことになるとはのう。\n おぬしを 村から 送りだした時には\n: "To think this would happen. When I sent you off from the village, I never dreamed of it.
tm.「……そんなカオをするでない。\n 大丈夫じゃ 村のみんなも わかっておる。\n: "...Don't make that face. It's all right, everyone in the village understands. It's not your fault.
tm.「おぬしの探してくれた者たちの 助力もあって\n ようやく 村が元通りの姿に 戻: "Thanks to the people you found, the village is finally back to its old self. Thank you.
tm.「じゃが 助けを求めているのは\n わしらだけでは ないはずじゃ。\n 世界中が: "But we can't be the only ones calling for help. The whole world needs your strength.
tm.「世界中からの期待に こたえる……\n それこそが 勇者の使命というもの。\n: "Answering the world's expectations is the Luminary's mission. It's hard, but do your best.
tm.「おぬしと結婚したいと\n 最初に エマから 相談されたときは\n さすがに お: "When Gemma first told me she wanted to marry you, I was quite surprised.
tm.「じゃが 勇者として旅を続けるうちに\n おぬしも 立派に大人となった。\n 復: "But as you traveled on as the Luminary, you grew into a fine adult. I saw that through the rebuilding.
tm.「……おてんばな孫娘じゃが\n 末永く よろしく頼むぞ ムコ殿。: "...She's a tomboy of a granddaughter, but please take care of her for years to come, my boy.
